The slice runs from section 8.482.42's heading through the end of section 8.482.44, which is the rule's last paragraph before section 8.482.45 (Enforcement by the Department); the slice is a superset of the single payment-charge provision needed, kept whole because 8.482.42, .43 and .44 cross-reference each other by section number throughout and none reads independently.
